title: AIIMS Nagpur Notification 2026 - Apply Online for 72 Senior Resident Posts
description: All India Institute of Medical Sciences Nagpur (AIIMS Nagpur)  has released an official notification for the recruitment of 72 Senior Resident Posts. Candidates who have qualified in MD/MS can apply for the AIIMS Nagpur Recruitment 2026 . Here, we have included the age limit, selection process, salary structure, education details, application fee, and how to apply for these posts. The application process has already started.
